evals.prompt: Our agent occasionally seems to loop for a really long time - can you check what's actually stopping it?
evals.expected_output: Uses the architecture map if present, checks step cap/timeout/loop detection specifically, traces failure propagation (does a failed tool call retry unboundedly), and writes an LLM-RL-NNN finding with a concrete worst-case impact statement.

evals.prompt: We have two agents that can call each other - could they get stuck looping each other even though each one individually has a step cap?
evals.expected_output: Specifically checks for a global cross-agent budget in addition to each agent's own cap, flagging the gap if only per-agent caps exist.
